overview_description.description:
Veryfi is an AI-powered Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) platform that captures documents and extracts accurate, structured data from unstructured inputs—such as receipts, invoices, checks, shipping labels, and industry-specific forms—through enterprise-grade APIs and SDKs. Veryfi enables product and operations teams to automate high-volume document workflows including expense management, accounts payable, reimbursements, insurance intake, logistics documentation, and identity/document verification by converting images and PDFs into clean, normalized data in seconds.

Veryfi’s product suite includes: (1) AI-driven document extraction APIs supporting diverse document types, languages, and geographies; (2) Veryfi Lens, an embeddable capture framework for mobile and web applications designed to improve image quality, reduce user friction, and increase downstream extraction accuracy; and (3) a fraud detection and prevention suite that helps organizations identify manipulated documents at the point of intake, including digital tampering and AI-generated or synthetic artifacts.

Built for enterprise reliability and scale, Veryfi prioritizes real-time performance, automation-first processing (no human-in-the-loop), configurable data outputs for downstream systems, and robust security and compliance practices, including SOC 2 Type II positioning. Veryfi is headquartered in San Mateo, California.
